subject: Request: Sprint bridge credit for early ramp — VP/CFO signoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Sprint bridge credit for early ramp — VP/CFO signoff

Hi team,

Quick summary: Clearsight (pilot account) is requesting a short-term subsidy to bridge Q3 onboarding while their usage ramps. The ask is a $45k credit applied over the first 60 days of production to offset higher-than-expected ingestion costs and keep the pilot timeline intact. They signaled that without help they will pause the pilot and re-evaluate alternative providers.

Why this is time-sensitive:
- Customer go-live scheduled 8/30; procurement needs commercial terms for SOW and PO.
- Forecasted incremental revenue in Q4 looks like ~$250k ARR if we keep to the original timeline.

Proposal (internal):
- One-time credit of $45,000 allocated to usage charges, applied in two equal tranches (day 1 and day 30).
- Credit conditioned on a 9-month committed minimum for the production package (standard enterprise tier).
- Include a clawback if they terminate within 90 days.

Attachments: attached the redlined MAP and our 90-day usage forecast for their account.

Request: I need VP/CFO-level concurrence to approve an exception to the standard credit ceiling (this exceeds the usual $25k field approval). Can Markus and Lauren weigh in by EOD? If approved, I will coordinate the DocuSign amendment and Ops routing.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: clearsight-MAP-v2-redline.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: usage-forecast-q3.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sprint bridge credit for early ramp — VP/CFO signoff

Olga — thanks for the write-up and attachments. A few clarifying Qs before I voice support:
1) Is the $45k gross credit (vendor-facing) or net to us after estimated cloud charges? The forecast sheet shows a wide range; want to ensure we aren't subsidizing platform costs beyond what makes commercial sense.
2) Do we have precedent for a two-tranche schedule tied to delivery milestones? If not, let's call it out in the amendment.
3) What exactly will be the acceptance criteria for the clawback? Prefer minimal complexity (e.g., full clawback if customer cancels within 30 days, pro rata after).

If we can tighten the clawback and confirm the $45k is net impact to Redwood, I'm inclined to approve subject to Markus/Finance signoff. Also, please include the internal margin on projected Q4 ARR in a single-line summary — helps execs make the call quickly.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Request: Sprint bridge credit for early ramp — VP/CFO signoff

Thanks for flagging, team. High-level thoughts:
- I support a temporary credit tied to explicit milestones (go-live + 30d active usage). It preserves the relationship while protecting revenue.
- Suggest tightening the clawback to: full clawback if cancellation before day 30; 50% clawback between day 31–90; none thereafter. Keeps it simple operationally.
- Require a signed 9-month commitment amendment (start date = first production invoice) and PO by 8/26 to qualify.

Marissa — on your economics ask: Olga, can you add a single-line margin impact that shows net to Redwood (post-cloud) for the $45k credit? I want to be clear on runway impact for the quarter.

Markus — can you provide executive concurrence? If yes, I propose we route a short exec memo and DocuSign link to the customer immediately.

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sprint bridge credit for early ramp — VP/CFO signoff

Team — reviewed the ask and the attachments. Approved with the following strict conditions:
1) Credit capped at $45,000 net impact to Redwood (finance will verify cloud offset assumptions before activation).
2) Customer must sign the 9-month commitment amendment and return a PO by COB 2026-08-26.
3) Clawback schedule as proposed by Lauren: full before day 30; 50% between day 31–90; none after 90.
4) Legal to include a single-line explicit expiration clause for the offer (auto-expire if PO not received by 8/26).
5) Customer operations to confirm technical readiness checklist for go-live; credit only applied after first production invoice posts.

Next steps (Olga):
- Prepare a one-page exec memo addressed to Finance/CFO with net margin impact (Marissa please add the single-line).
- Send a DocuSign amendment (I authorize the signature routing) and copy finance ops; include attachments.
- Ops: hold off on provisioning subsidy until finance signs off on net impact.

I don't want this to be a precedent for open-ended credits. Document the rationale in the deal record (SALE-4421).

Markus Klein
VP Commercial & Finance (acting CFO)
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
